messages.content: Summarize the text in one sentence of at most 25 words. Plain text only, no preamble, no bullet points.
I bought the Aurora lamp for my desk. The light is warm and the dimmer is smooth, but the base is lighter than it looks and it tipped over twice when I bumped the desk. Good lamp, wobbly stand.

response.text: The Aurora lamp has a warm light and smooth dimmer, but its lightweight base makes it prone to tipping over.
